import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive visualization with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
sleep_disorder_filled = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorder_filled.unique():
    mask = sleep_disorder_filled == disorder
    plt.scatter(df.loc[mask, 'Sleep Duration'], 
               df.loc[mask, 'Quality of Sleep'],
               alpha=0.6, label=disorder, s=50)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Disorders
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder_filled.value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(disorder_counts))
plt.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=colors)
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Disorders', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Stress Level by Occupation (Top 8)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(8).index
df_top_occ = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
occupation_stress = df_top_occ.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
plt.barh(range(len(occupation_stress)), occupation_stress.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(occupation_stress)))
plt.yticks(range(len(occupation_stress)), occupation_stress.index, fontsize=9)
plt.xlabel('Average Stress Level', fontsize=10)
plt.title('Average Stress Level by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
plt.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
           c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', alpha=0.6, s=50)
plt.xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
plt.title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar()
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
plt.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. BMI Category Distribution by Gender
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
bmi_gender = pd.crosstab(df['BMI Category'], df['Gender'])
bmi_gender.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], alpha=0.8)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
plt.title('BMI Category Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=9)
plt.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Age vs Heart Rate colored by Sleep Duration
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
scatter = plt.scatter(df['Age'], df['Heart Rate'], 
                     c=df['Sleep Duration'], cmap='coolwarm', 
                     alpha=0.6, s=50)
plt.xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
plt.title('Age vs Heart Rate by Sleep Duration', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=9)
plt.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
